definitions.active_accounts: Subscriptions with status active on the as-of timestamp.
definitions.arpa: mrr / active_accounts, rounded to the nearest cent.
definitions.first_response_median_minutes: Median first-response business minutes for tickets opened in the window.
definitions.mrr: Sum of active subscription MRR in cents on the as-of timestamp. Trialing and cancelled contribute 0. Do not sum daily MRR across a month.
definitions.seats: Seats on active subscriptions on the as-of timestamp. Billing is authoritative when it disagrees with CRM.
definitions.sla_breaches: Opened tickets whose first response exceeded the priority target (urgent 60, high 120, normal 480, low 1440 business minutes).
definitions.tickets_opened: Tickets whose openedAt falls in the month window (November ends at the dataset now).

note: Computed from generator state. Do not derive this by querying a warehouse built from student SQL.
